prompt.text:
Implement immutable navigation calculations in package `solution` using only the standard library.

Export:

```go
type Frame struct {
    East      float64
    North     float64
    Up        float64
    Azimuth   float64
    Elevation float64
}

func Advance(frame Frame, distance float64) (Frame, error)
func Reorient(frame Frame, deltaAzimuth, deltaElevation float64) (Frame, error)
```

Azimuth is measured in degrees clockwise from positive North toward positive East. Elevation is measured in degrees upward from the horizontal plane. `Advance` moves by `distance` along the current orientation: its horizontal magnitude is `distance*cos(elevation)`, and its vertical component is `distance*sin(elevation)`. Negative distances move backward. It must preserve orientation except that a finite azimuth outside the canonical range is normalized in the result.

`Reorient` adds both deltas, normalizes azimuth into the half-open interval `[0, 360)`, and clamps elevation to `[-90, 90]`.

Every numeric field of the input and every numeric argument must be finite: NaN and either infinity are malformed. The input elevation must already lie within `[-90, 90]`. On malformed input, return the original frame unchanged and a non-nil error. Zero-distance advancement and zero-delta reorientation still normalize azimuth. The functions receive and return values and therefore must not mutate any caller-owned state. Return a complete source file without a `main` function.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
